doc: What a battle sounds like (M2-AUD-04; game/audio/battle_audio.gd, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). Every value is an sfx row (sfx_battle.json). vfx: each BattleVfx effect id (effects.json), played when the view plays it (effect_played), so a sound follows its particle; every effect has one (validate_data). skills: an engine skill_id on action_resolved. events: rim_break (charge_broken), vowbound_call, vowbound_dismiss, vowbound_fell. fields_cleared and phases: by field or phase id. openings: the battle's opening. outcomes: battle_finished. Sections other than vfx are fallbacks for moments the view may also play: a fallback is dropped when the same sound played within dedupe_ms. Repeats of one vfx sound within repeat_ms (an action's other targets) layer at layer_db. Reduced audio (accessibility.json reduced_audio): those repeats are skipped (one layer per action), `reduced` swaps a sound for its version without sub-bass, and the SFX bank plays at reduced_level during the battle. vowbound_stings: a called Vowbound's base id -> its own sting (on the Music bus), after vowbound_call.
